problem: Backend operations and inventory visibility across three warehouses (Chicago, Dallas, Phoenix) are disjointed, causing double-allocation of stock and daily phone coordination. Ops reporting is manual in spreadsheets taking 4-5 hours weekly.
goals: All five locations (including upcoming Atlanta and Seattle) visible in one real-time dashboard
Eliminate daily inter-warehouse phone calls for stock verification
Automate weekly operations reporting to replace 4-5 hour manual spreadsheets
Deploy a user-friendly system operable by current ops staff without developer overhead
Preserve in-house developer Raj's custom legacy architecture work
budget: $50,000 target (board-approved range up to $120,000 with flexibility)
timeline: Q3 target launch (approx 5 months) with Q4 confirmed fallback before Atlanta Q1 opening

industry.source_quote: three warehouse locations... on Shopify for the direct-to-consumer side, that's maybe 20% of our volume

budget.source_quote: We've set aside fifty thousand for this... Actually Marcus, I thought we discussed up to a hundred and twenty? The board approved a range, not a fixed number.

timeline.value: End of Q3 target with Q4 fallback
timeline.source_quote: need the system stable by end of Q3 this year? That's roughly five months from now... Q4 is probably more realistic.

missing_fields: Selected shipping software platform (not yet chosen — marked for future phase)
Detailed staff scheduling requirements (deprioritized by CEO for initial phase)
